description: The diagnoses_icd table stores ICD-10 codes for diagnoses associated with hospital admissions, linked to both the admission and patient records.
The labevents table stores laboratory event data, including test results and corresponding specimen information, for each patient visit.
The d_icd_diagnoses table stores ICD-10 diagnosis codes and their corresponding long titles, enabling healthcare professionals to efficiently retrieve and analyze diagnostic information.

The d_icd_procedures table contains a comprehensive repository of International Classification of Diseases (ICD) procedures, which are used for coding and classification of medical procedures. The table stores the ICD procedure codes, their corresponding versions, and long titles to facilitate accurate diagnosis and treatment planning.
The emar table stores electronic medication administration records (EMARs) for inpatient patients, linking them to their corresponding hospital admission and patient information.

The hcpcsevents table stores detailed information about HCPCS codes and their corresponding events in the hospital's billing system. It contains data on the date, sequence number, and short description of each event.

The d_labitems table stores information about laboratory items, including their unique identifiers, labels, fluid types, and categories. This data is used to support clinical decision-making and quality improvement initiatives.
The pharmacy table stores detailed information about medication administration to patients in the hospital, including dosing schedules, infusion types, and dispensation details.
The OMR table stores laboratory results data, specifically the result values and corresponding sequence numbers for each patient visit.

The poe_detail table stores detailed information about patient outcomes (Poe) for each treatment or procedure performed on a subject. It contains the sequence number, Poe ID, subject ID, field name and value of the outcome.
The poe table stores information about orders and transactions in the hospital, including details on patient demographics, admission status, order type, and transaction history.
The procedures_icd table stores information on medical procedures performed on patients, including the ICD code and version used for billing and coding purposes.
The provider table stores information about healthcare professionals, including their unique identifiers and relevant details.
The drgcodes table stores detailed discharge group codes for inpatient stays, linking them to the corresponding hospital admission and patient records.
The emar_detail table stores detailed information about medication administration records (MARs) for patients in the hospital.

The d_hcpcs table contains standardized Healthcare Common Procedure Coding System (HCPCS) codes, which are used to classify medical procedures and services. This information is essential for accurate billing, coding, and reimbursement purposes.

The microbiologyevents table stores detailed records of laboratory test results and specimen handling events for inpatients, including information on the type of test performed, specimen characteristics, and clinical interpretations.
The prescriptions table stores information about medications prescribed to patients, including details on the medication itself, the patient's medical history and current treatment plan.
The services table stores information about medical interventions and treatments provided to patients during their hospital stay.
The transfers table stores information on patient transfers within the hospital, including the subject's ID, admission and discharge times, and care unit assignments.

The patients table stores demographic and vital information for individual subjects, including their age at the time of enrollment (anchor_age) and date of death (dod). This data is used to track patient outcomes and inform clinical decision-making.
The admissions table stores information about patient admissions to the hospital, including admission and discharge details, medical history, and demographic data.
The Caregiver table stores information about caregivers who provide care to ICU patients, including their identification details and contact information.
The inputevents table in the mimiciv_icu database captures critical care interventions and events for ICU patients, providing a detailed record of their treatment and care.

The ingredientevents table in the mimiciv_icu schema captures medication administration events for intensive care unit (ICU) patients, including details on the item administered, amount, rate, and caregiver involved.

The chartevents table stores detailed information about medication administration events in the intensive care unit (ICU), including the date and time of administration, the medication ID, dosage, and units of measurement.
The icustays table stores information on intensive care unit (ICU) stays, including patient demographics, admission and discharge details, and treatment outcomes.

The d_items table in the mimiciv_icu schema contains information about medical devices and equipment used in intensive care units (ICUs). It provides details on device characteristics, such as label, abbreviation, category, unit name, and parameter type, which are essential for monitoring and managing patient care.
The datetimeevents table stores detailed records of medication administration, vital sign monitoring, and other interventions performed on ICU patients during their hospital stay.
Output events table for intensive care unit (ICU) data, containing vital sign and medication administration records.
Procedure events table for intensive care unit (ICU) data, containing information on medical procedures performed on patients during their stay.
